Proxy Statement Pursuant to Section 14(a) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934

Preliminary Proxy Statement

MERGER PROPOSED — YOUR VOTE IS VERY IMPORTANT

Dear Stockholder: On June 15, 2026, SmallCap Industries Inc. entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Acquirer Holdings LLC, pursuant to which Acquirer will acquire all outstanding shares of SmallCap common stock for $12.50 per share in cash, representing a premium of approximately 42% over the closing price on the last trading day before announcement.

The special meeting of stockholders will be held on August 20, 2026. The board of directors unanimously recommends that you vote FOR the merger agreement.

If the merger agreement is terminated under specified circumstances, SmallCap will be required to pay Acquirer a termination fee of $9,000,000.

The merger is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to stockholder approval and customary closing conditions.
